analysis.primaryGoal: Inspire shops to create summer-themed product displays using Westpack packaging solutions
analysis.audience: Retailers and shops interested in seasonal display and packaging inspiration

visualStyle.imageStyle: Professional, light-drenched photography with summer motifs

structure: Explanation of the look and what it achieves
copyStyle.urgency: Mild; primary focus is on inspiration and preparation

reusablePatterns: Segmenting product inspiration by thematic story (e.g. 'Den støvede sommeraften', 'Et iskoldt dyp')
Mix of lifestyle context photographs with isolated product images
Short, actionable suggestions within each themed section ('Prøv det også her:')
Large, consistent CTAs at the end of each section
Soft, pastel backgrounds to unify visual theme
risks: Heavily seasonal theme limits reuse outside of summer
Visual and text-heavy approach may not suit action-driven campaigns
No explicit promotions may reduce perceived value for deal-oriented segments

confidence.notes: All sections and most CTAs are visible and readable, some minor body text detail obscured in smallest fonts.
